title: Expected area of the star hull of planar Brownian motion and bridge
summary: We study the star hull of planar Brownian motion and bridge, and relate this random compact set to the more familiar convex and topological hulls. Roughly speaking, the star hull is the smallest starshaped set (with respect to the origin) that contains the trace of the path. In particular, we prove that the expected areas of the star hulls are $\frac{3π}{8}$ and $\fracπ{4}$ for planar Brownian motion and bridge, respectively.
